tools.name: take_screenshot
tools.description: Render a public web page and return it as an image (or a PDF, or a video of the page scrolling). Uses one screenshot of the account quota; cache hits and failed renders are free. Prefer jpeg or webp to keep the image small. A result over 6 MB comes back as a download link (valid for about a day) ins

tools.name: list_devices
tools.description: List the device presets accepted by the viewport_device argument of take_screenshot. Needs no access key.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "take_screenshot" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
